# Geelong Kitchen Renovations

Geelong Kitchen Renovations (https://geelongkitchenrenovations.com.au/) is a free referral and quote service for people who want kitchen renovation work in Geelong, Victoria, Australia. It does not renovate kitchens itself. Enquiries from the quote form are passed to one local kitchen renovator who services the customer's area, and that business contacts the customer directly.

## Important facts
- No phone number is published on the site.
- The site does not publish its own prices, reviews or ranking claims. Cost guides cite named public sources.
- Rules pages summarise official VIC government and council sources, with links.
- Contact for enquiries and privacy requests: quotes@geelongkitchenrenovations.com.au.
